title: 构筑华夏 · 中国经典建筑与传统结构代表性目录
titleEn: Built in China — A Representative Catalogue of Chinese Traditional Buildings and Structures
scope: 代表性样本，非穷尽名录。首批 42 例，用于面向全球读者的科普展示与 3D 教学模型选题。
scopeEn: A representative sample, not an exhaustive inventory. 42 cases in this first release, for public education and as the basis for 3D teaching models.

historical-continuity.labelEn: Continuing tradition — no single founding date

dougong.gloss: Bracket set — a stepped cluster of blocks and arms that transfers roof load outward and down into the column.

mortise-tenon.gloss: Mortise and tenon — a projecting tenon fits a matching cut socket, locking two timbers without nails.

tailiang.gloss: The column-and-beam frame: columns carry beams stacked in tiers, each tier smaller than the one below.

chuandou.gloss: Columns are tied by penetrating tie-beams; purlins rest directly on the columns, so the frame is dense and braced.

mixed-frame.gloss: Lower storeys use chuandou ties for stiffness, upper storeys use tailiang tiers to gain height.

ganlan.gloss: The floor is raised on posts above damp ground; the gap underneath is used for ventilation, animals and storage.

jinggan.gloss: Horizontal logs are stacked in a criss-cross frame, each course notched into the one below.

stone-arch.gloss: Wedge-shaped blocks (voussoirs) lean against each other; the compression line keeps the arch standing.

timber-arch-bridge.gloss: Short logs are woven and pegged into a basket-like arch that spans far beyond the length of one beam.

chain-bridge.gloss: Chains or ropes carry the deck; the load pulls down and sideways, and the anchorages take the pull.

rammed-earth.gloss: Earth is compacted in thin lifts inside formwork; lime and gravel improve strength and water resistance.

yaodong.gloss: Rooms are hollowed out of a loess cliff or dug below ground; the soil itself is the structure.

bamboo.gloss: Bamboo culms are lashed and tied; a light, flexible frame that is rebuilt rather than repaired.

elevated-deck.gloss: A tall masonry or rammed platform raises the timber hall above the ground, protecting it from damp.

masonry-tower.gloss: A tapering stack of storeys built of brick or stone; each storey repeats a simple structural bay.

yurt-lattice.gloss: A collapsible lattice of poles carries a felt skin; it is taken down and rebuilt with the herd.

cave.gloss: Chambers are excavated into living rock; the cliff mass is both the enclosure and the structure.

roof-form.gloss: The typology of the roof — hipped, gabled, hip-and-gable, pyramidal, multi-eaved — which carries rank and climate as much as it carries load.

courtyard.gloss: The enclosed plan unit of a Chinese dwelling: ranges of rooms closed by a screen wall, which organises family structure, daylight and ventilation at once.

cross-plan.gloss: A hall whose frames run in two directions and meet at the centre, with porches on all four sides — the plan of the Mani Hall at Longxing Temple.

caisson.gloss: A flat coffered ceiling or a stepped central caisson that conceals the frame, marks the rank of the space and protects it from fire and dust.

fieldNotes.yearUncertainty: 确切 = 来源明确且少有争议；约略 = 来源之间存在分歧或学界仍在讨论；不适用 = 持续性传统，无单一始建年。
fieldNotes.evidenceLevel: primary-verified = 本任务实际访问并读到该页内容；primary-cited = 官方机构页面，内容经官方发布稿转述；secondary = 百科类来源，仅作补充。
fieldNotes.caveat: 每条常驻，提示年代争议、修复痕迹、与「测绘/工程模型」的边界。
fieldNotes.imagePlan.status: 本目录不携带任何第三方图片。19 号应程序化生成配图并外链来源。

teachingNotice.labelZh: 教学示意，非施工/工程模型
teachingNotice.labelEn: Teaching illustration — not a construction or engineering model.
teachingNotice.forceNoteZh: 受力箭头为定性说明，非工程计算；箭头仅表示传力方向，不表示大小。
teachingNotice.forceNoteEn: Force arrows are qualitative, not an engineering calculation; they indicate the direction of load transfer, not its magnitude.
appliesTo: 受力箭头、推力线与传力路径
teachingNotice.disclaimer: 本目录中的全部 3D 模型、剖面与受力说明均为教学示意，非施工工序、非工程计算、非测绘成果。
mustNotClaim: 不得声称是测绘成果或复原依据
不得给出荷载、应力、允许跨度等工程数值

unescoIdVerification.method: UNESCO 世界遗产中心官方 GeoJSON 端点逐条核对 id_no 与正式名称
unescoIdVerification.note: 端点同时返回每条遗产的组成部分（component_name），用于确认「某建筑是否为该遗产的组成部分」这一关系，例如洛阳桥属 1561、佛光寺东大殿属 1279。

limitations: 本目录为代表性样本，不声称覆盖或穷尽中国全部古建筑；同一类型内的其他重要实例未被纳入。
所有 3D 模型、剖面与受力说明均为教学示意，非施工或工程模型；受力箭头为定性说明，非计算结果。
建筑年代多含「始建于 X、重修于 Y」的多层信息，本目录以 yearText + yearUncertainty 表达，不用单一年份冒充断代。
参考图片一律不下载、不再分发；imagePlan 记录状态与替代方案。
本任务未对每一个案例做现场或原始档案核验；核验强度以 verification.level 与 evidenceLevel 标注。
